programs.name: JET Programme 2027 (Assistant Language Teacher)
programs.deadlineLabel: Applications must reach the Embassy of Japan in India by email on or before 30 October 2026
programs.funding: Paid job, not a scholarship: about ¥4.02 million in year 1 (roughly ₹23-24 lakh), rising each year. Flight to Japan paid by the hiring organisation.
programs.eligibility: Indian passport holders with a bachelor's degree (any subject) by July 2027. No Japanese needed for the ALT track. A short audio recording is compulsory.
programs.note: Only the ALT track is open for India this round. The CIR track closed on 13 March 2026.

programs.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships 2027/28
programs.funding: Funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office: tuition, airfare and a living allowance.
programs.eligibility: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries, including India. A 2:1 honours degree (or 2:2 plus a relevant postgraduate qualification) by September 2027. Applying through a nominator is compulsory.
programs.note: For master's study starting September/October 2027. Nominators may set earlier internal cut-offs.

programs.name: English Language Assistants in France (Assistant d'anglais) 2027-28
programs.funding: Paid 7-month contract (1 October 2027 to 30 April 2028) in French public schools, about 12 classroom hours a week. The India page does not state the pay figure; the programme FAQ has current terms.
programs.eligibility: Indian students and young graduates. Around 200 Indians are selected each year through the Embassy of France and Institut Français en Inde.
programs.note: The closest programme to Japan's JET for Indians: teach English in France, no teaching degree needed.

programs.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters 2027 (European Union)
programs.deadlineLabel: Each master's sets its own date; most close between December 2026 and January 2027
programs.funding: Full scholarship for the best-ranked applicants: participation costs, travel, visa and a living allowance.
programs.eligibility: A bachelor's degree, or final year of bachelor's with graduation before the master's starts. Indians apply directly to each programme's consortium.
programs.note: Apply directly to each master's through the official Erasmus Mundus catalogue; there is no single central form.

programs.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-28
programs.deadlineLabel: Applications open since 20 August 2026; the deadline for India is set by the Swiss Embassy in New Delhi
programs.funding: Monthly stipend for PhD, research or postdoctoral stays at Swiss universities and federal institutes.
programs.eligibility: Mainly early-career researchers who already hold a master's degree (by 31 July 2027). No scholarships for bachelor or master's study, except limited arts scholarships.
programs.note: Check the India country page on the FCS/SERI site for the exact Indian deadline and the embassy contact.

programs.name: Stipendium Hungaricum 2027/28
programs.deadlineLabel: 2027/28 call not yet published; expected around November 2026 to mid-January 2027 (last cycle closed 15 January)
programs.funding: All tuition fees covered and accommodation costs supported, plus a monthly stipend.
programs.eligibility: Indian applicants are eligible (India is a partner country). Applications go through the official online system with nomination by the Indian sending partner.
programs.note: Hungarian embassies confirm the 2027/28 call is not out yet. Treat any earlier date from third-party sites as unconfirmed.

programs.name: Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Burslari) 2027
programs.deadlineLabel: 2027 window not yet announced; the 2026 window was 10 January to 20 February
programs.funding: Government-funded: financial support, university placement, accommodation and flights for bachelor's, master's, PhD and research.
programs.eligibility: Open to international students of all countries, including India. Merit-based, online application, free of charge.
programs.note: Applications are received in one period each year on the official portal only.

programs.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) 2027/28
programs.deadlineLabel: 2027/28 call not yet published; the 2026/27 call closed on 1 February 2026 (next expected around November 2026)
programs.funding: Full funding for study in China: tuition, accommodation and a living stipend, by degree level.
programs.eligibility: Apply online via campuschina.org under the Chinese Embassy in India (agency number 3561). From the 2026/27 year, undergraduate applicants must also take the CSCA test.
programs.note: CSC never uses paid agents or intermediaries; apply only through the official system.

programs.name: MEXT Scholarship - research students (Embassy recommendation)
programs.deadlineLabel: Embassy recruitment runs April to May for arrival the following year; next expected April-May 2027
programs.funding: Full tuition, monthly stipend and airfare for graduate study and research in Japan.
programs.eligibility: Indian graduates applying through the Embassy of Japan in India; first screening at the embassy between May and July.
programs.note: Never send documents directly to MEXT in Japan; the embassy route is the only one for India.

programs.name: Fulbright-Nehru Fellowships 2028-29
programs.deadlineLabel: The 2027-28 cycle closed on 1 July 2026; the next call is expected in early 2027
programs.funding: Fully funded master's, doctoral and research fellowships in the United States (funding, airfare and insurance per USIEF).
programs.eligibility: Indian citizens; requirements vary by fellowship category on the USIEF site.
programs.note: USIEF (United States-India Educational Foundation) is the only official channel in India.

programs.name: Language and Culture Assistants in Spain (for Indian citizens)
programs.deadlineLabel: 2026-27 closed (applications ran 2-30 June 2026); the next call is expected around May-June 2027
programs.funding: Paid assistantship in Spanish schools, November to May, for part-time classroom hours.
programs.eligibility: Indian citizens; accredited C1 English and A2 Spanish (DELE or SIELE); university graduate or final year; clean record for the visa. Maximum 2 years for Indians.
programs.note: Run by Spain's Ministry of Education, which charges no fee. Any payment request means it is not the official programme.

programs.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
programs.deadlineLabel: Undergraduate 2027 (embassy track) closed 30 September 2026; the graduate call is expected around February 2027
programs.funding: Full funding: tuition, airfare, monthly allowance and Korean language training.
programs.eligibility: Indian citizens via the Embassy of Korea in India (embassy track) or directly through universities (university track).
programs.note: Embassy track applications are filed on the Study in Korea portal inside the announced window only.

programs.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
programs.deadlineLabel: The 2026 call closed on 12 March 2026; the 2027 call is expected around December 2026 to March 2027
programs.funding: €10,000 stipend plus a full fee waiver for one year of master's or PhD study. 60 scholarships a year.
programs.eligibility: High-calibre international students, including Indians, with an offer from an Irish higher education institution.
programs.note: Managed by Ireland's Higher Education Authority; one application per candidate per cycle.

programs.name: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship (BDGS) 2027/28
programs.deadlineLabel: 2027/28 dates not yet announced; the 2026/27 cycle ran 15 December 2025 to 15 February 2026
programs.funding: Tuition, monthly allowance, accommodation and airfare for diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate study in Brunei.
programs.eligibility: Open to international applicants, including Indians, through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs portal.
programs.note: Watch the official MFA page for the 2027/28 announcement; expected around mid-December 2026.

programs.name: Chevening Scholarships 2028/29
programs.deadlineLabel: 2027/28 applications closed in early October 2026; the next cycle opens in August 2027
programs.funding: Fully funded one-year UK master's: tuition, monthly stipend and airfare.
programs.eligibility: Indian citizens with an undergraduate degree and at least two years of work experience.
programs.note: Applications open every August and close around early October. Mark August 2027.

notEligible.name: EPIK (English Program in Korea)
notEligible.why: Open only to citizens of seven listed native-English countries; India is not one of them.

notEligible.name: British Council Language Assistants
notEligible.why: Requires a UK (or limited European) passport; not open to Indians.

notEligible.name: Australia Awards
notEligible.why: India is not on the current list of participating countries.

notEligible.name: DAAD WISE (research internship)
notEligible.why: Discontinued; no current call. Other DAAD schemes have their own deadlines.
